passage.title: Original practice poem 'My Name', written for Tarbiyyah Global Academy
paras: At school they broke my name in half
and threw away the harder part.
I let them. I was seven.
I wanted to be easy to say.
But my grandmother said it whole,
each sound in its proper place,
the way you lay a table
Now, when a new teacher pauses,
I say it for her, slowly, all of it,
